g.text: Core · one Qt event loop, five services
`Core::run()` — identity → settings → database → games → logger → sockets → timers
UDP `:27900` — one socket for heartbeats, queries and replies
TCP `:28900` — one connection per list or sync request
`QTimer` schedule — uplink 60 s · sync 1800 s · checker 250 ms · maintenance 60 s
Game servers — send a heartbeat to UDP `:27900` about once a minute
Game clients — TCP challenge, then a list request
Peer masterservers — same protocol, in both directions
`BeaconServer` — parse a heartbeat, insert or refresh the row, challenge a new beacon
`replyQuery` — answer `secure`, `basic`, `info`, `rules`, `status`, `echo` aimed at the master itself
`compileServerlist` / `compileSyncList` — live rows to `ip:port` text or enctype2 bytes
`SyncUpdater` — ticker over configured peers plus the external HTTP list merge
`SyncClient` — dial a peer, answer its challenge, request a sync, upsert what comes back
`StatusChecker` — poll every live row for `info`/`status`, store serverinfo and players
`Maintenance` — refresh per-game stats, prune stale beacons, orphaned info and players
`overrides.cpp` — per-game key, gamename and validate exceptions
`data/masterserver.db` — SQLite in WAL mode, one writer
in-process only — `_beaconList` pending challenges, checker buffers
`serverlist` — ip, queryport, gamename, auth/direct flags, 4 timestamps
`serverinfo` — host, map, counts and rules from the last check
`playerinfo` — one row per player the checker saw
`versioninfo` — schema version, refuses a stale database
